comment: The arrival of a coronal mass ejection (CME) from 6th Oct is anticipated during the first forecast interval. This is likely to lead to periods of ACTIVE and STORM G1 geomagnetic conditions, with a chance for some STORM G2 periods. Activity may continue into the second forecast interval, before easing back to QUIET conditions. Another CME was observed leaving the Sun yesterday, associated with a C7.9 class solar flare. This could have a glancing impact during the third forecast interval, which may lead to some ACTIVE periods, with a chance for some brief STORM G1 periods.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
